items.title: Toots Thielemans — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Oh, and Jacques [Belzer?], the alto player who played a lot later on with Chet Baker.

ctx.x: But he had this place he played a lot in Paris, but he never really came to the States. Then that was [inaudible]. Oh, and Jacques [Belzer?], the alto player who played a lot later on with Chet Baker.
